title: Pruning for Protection: Increasing Jailbreak Resistance in Aligned LLMs Without Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper investigates 'safety alignment' and 'jailbreak resistance,' which are the primary mechanisms used to ensure LLMs adhere to ethical guidelines and human values. It benchmarks model performance on a dataset containing harmful tasks such as hate speech and unlawful behaviors, focusing on whether models maintain their moral and safety guardrails under adversarial pressure.
